name: Insulin glargine
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Drugs that raise hypoglycemia risk (other antidiabetics, ACE inhibitors, ARBs, fibrates, fluoxetine, MAO inhibitors, salicylates, sulfonamide antibiotics, GLP-1 agonists, DPP-4 and SGLT2 inhibitors)
key_interactions.action: Insulin dose reduction and more frequent glucose checks may be needed.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Drugs that blunt insulin (corticosteroids, diuretics, atypical antipsychotics, estrogens, oral contraceptives, isoniazid, niacin, protease inhibitors, sympathomimetics, thyroid hormones)
key_interactions.action: Insulin dose increase and more frequent glucose checks may be needed.

key_interactions.effect: May raise or lower glucose and mask hypoglycemia symptoms (label).
Unpredictable glucose effects; pentamidine can cause hypoglycemia then hyperglycemia (label).
key_interactions.action: Adjust the dose and monitor glucose.
